task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the requirements file on the Desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of ~/Desktop/skysurvey_orbit_requirements.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent configures the GMAT ForceModel to include Earth, Luna (Moon), and Sun gravity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT GUI 'ForceModel' configuration panel showing 'Luna' and 'Sun' added to the Point Masses or Gravity list.

task_completion.description: Agent sets the spacecraft orbital parameters to target a ~13.66 day period (SMA approx 243,000 km).
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT GUI 'Spacecraft' state panel showing an Orbit Epoch and Keplerian/Cartesian elements consistent with a high-altitude lunar resonant orbit.

task_completion.description: Agent configures a Propagate command for at least 120 days.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT Mission Tree showing a 'Propagate' command with a 'StopCondition' or 'ElapsedDays' set to 120 or more.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the GMAT script to the specified output directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT 'Save As' dialog or a file explorer showing lunar_resonant_orbit.script in ~/GMAT_output/.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the resonance_stability_report.txt with the required metrics.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing ~/GMAT_output/resonance_stability_report.txt containing initial/final SMA, period, perigee altitude (>44,650 km), and stability assessment.

integrity.description: The agent used the GMAT GUI to design and propagate the orbit rather than just writing a text file manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the GMAT application window active, interacting with the Mission Tree, and running the simulation (blue progress bar or output console).

integrity.description: The agent did not create the report before running the simulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timestamp of the report creation in the terminal or file manager occurs after the GMAT execution/propagation is seen.

integrity.description: The values in the report match the output generated by the GMAT run.
integrity.visual_evidence: The SMA and Period values in the final report match the values visible in the GMAT 'Output' tabs or message window after the run.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target orbital period is 13.66 days (2:1 resonance with Moon's ~27.32 day sidereal period). This corresponds to a Semi-Major Axis (SMA) of approximately 243,000 km. The perigee altitude must remain above 44,650 km. The report must explicitly state 'moon_gravity_included: YES' and 'stability_assessment: STABLE' if the orbit maintains these parameters over the 120-day propagation. The script must be saved to ~/GMAT_output/lunar_resonant_orbit.script.
